title_en: Chinese History (13/20): The May Fourth Movement
note_en: 不仅…也… links two claims, the second building on the first: 这场运动不仅是一场爱国行动，也推动了新文化运动的发展 "this movement was not only a patriotic act, it also drove the New Culture Movement forward." Unlike English "not only... but also," 不仅 sits after the subject (这场运动不仅是…), and the second part usually takes 也 or 而且 right before its verb.
